blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — The Department of Tourism (DOT) has urged local governments and tourism establishments in Eastern Visayas to prepare measures against El Niño, warning that prolonged dry conditions and warmer temperatures could affect water supplies, tourism operations, and visitor safety. In a public advisory issued on Tuesday, DOT-8 encouraged tourism stakeholders to review their contingency and business continuity plans, conserve water, ensure the availability of safe drinking water and essential facilities, and strengthen safety measures for outdoor and adventure activities.
